alternative_rule: Required gain = min(20, 0.5 * (120 - start_x)); count only completed eligible passes with strictly positive end_x-start_x that meet this required gain. Use decimal comparisons. At x=120, no positive in-pitch gain is possible.
comparison: Apply both definitions to exactly the lesson 66 completed-pass sample and unchanged registered minutes. Keep original results and show newly included pass identities. No threshold search or performance-label evaluation.
motivation: Lesson 67 showed the fixed 20-unit rule cannot qualify any pass starting beyond x=100. The alternative requires smaller gains near goal, with its breakpoint at x=80.
scope: Descriptive definition-sensitivity exercise on already inspected 2019 data. The fraction one half is a transparent project choice, not an optimized or universal standard. More qualifying passes does not establish a better metric or better players. No model fitting or validated action-value labels.
